lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Sunday, 20th September

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It was sunny in the morning. Su Hai, Mike, Liu Tao and I went to the park by bike.
lines.chinese: 早上天气晴朗。苏海、迈克、刘涛和我骑自行车去了公园。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: There was a parrot show in the park. We saw some interesting parrots.
lines.chinese: 公园里有一个鹦鹉表演。我们看到了一些有趣的鹦鹉。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Then, the weather became windy and cloudy. We flew kites high in the sky.
lines.chinese: 然后，天气变得有风又多云。我们把风筝放得很高。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It was time for lunch. We brought some jiaozi, some bread and honey and some drinks.
lines.chinese: 到吃午饭的时间了。我们带了一些饺子、面包和蜂蜜，还有一些饮料。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: We saw some ants on the bread and honey. There were some bees too. We could not eat our lunch!
lines.chinese: 我们看到面包和蜂蜜上有一些蚂蚁。还有一些蜜蜂。我们不能吃我们的午餐了！

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: In the afternoon, there were black clouds in the sky. It rained. We were hungry and wet.
lines.chinese: 下午，天空中出现了黑云。下雨了。我们又饿又湿。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: What a day!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Sam meets Bobby in the park.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: Hi, Bobby. You look sad. What's the matter?
lines.chinese: 你好，博比。你看起来很伤心。怎么了？

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: I lost my new kite.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Sam wants to know why.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: What happened, Bobby?

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: This morning, Tina and I flew my new kite in the park, but it wasn't windy in the park.
lines.chinese: 今天早上，蒂娜和我在公园放了我的新风筝，但是公园里没有风。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: What happened then?

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: We climbed up the hill. It was windy there.
lines.chinese: 我们爬上了小山。那里有风。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: What happened then?

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: The kite flew high, but it flew too high and we couldn't hold onto it. It flew away.
lines.chinese: 风筝飞得很高，但是它飞得太高了，我们抓不住它。它飞走了。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Sam laughs.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: Is this your kite?

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Yes!

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: Why do you have it?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: I found it near the hill!
lines.chinese: 我在小山附近发现了它！
